توادعت (form VI)
# تَوَادَعْتُ (tawādaʕtu) /ta.waː.daʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَوَادَعَ (tawādaʕa)
# تَوَادَعْتَ (tawādaʕta) /ta.waː.daʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَوَادَعَ (tawādaʕa)
# تَوَادَعْتِ (tawādaʕti) /ta.waː.daʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَوَادَعَ (tawādaʕa)
# تَوَادَعَتْ (tawādaʕat) /ta.waː.da.ʕat/: third-person fem
